dengue.source: OpenDengue V1.3 (compiled from Ministry of Health and WHO reports)

monthly.national_label: Sum of the states that reported that month
monthly.note: Monthly state figures exist for ten states and end in December 2010. The other states have no monthly series in this source.

yearly.note: Yearly state figures cover 2009 to 2018 and 2023; 2019 to 2022 are missing by state in this source. Selangor's 2017 and 2018 values are identical in the source, which may be an error there.

flu.note: No state-by-state influenza series is published in Malaysia, because influenza is not a notifiable disease. The only state figures are occasional snapshots in Ministry of Health statements, listed below.
